description: Get the environment variables configured for an app (names and values). Read-only — use vibekit_set_env to change them.
name: vibekit_app_env

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: The app's environment variables as key-value pairs.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Get Env Vars
